payload.title: Explain a C program: source lines to RISC-V instructions to bytes
payload.description:
As the student, I want to see which assembly instructions and machine-code bytes each line of my C produced.

Feature: Compilation explorer
  Scenario: Hovering a source line highlights its instructions
    Given a C program with a for loop is compiled for RISC-V
    When I hover the for line
    Then its instruction groups are highlighted in the assembly pane
  Scenario: Selecting an instruction shows its bit fields
    Given a compiled program
    When I select a store instruction
    Then the 32 bits are shown split into labelled opcode, register and immediate fields
